ai.seo_question: What is the role of the army and how is it funded according to Imam Ali's instructions to Malik al-Ashtar?
ai.summary: In this passage from the Letter to Malik al-Ashtar, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) establishes the army not merely as a military force but as the essential 'fortress' ensuring public security and religious dignity, funded by the state treasury (khraj). This highlights the Shia political principle that military strength is a public trust dependent on just fiscal management to maintain stability and deter enemies.
